name: cwmai_evolutionary_dependency_management_v3_v4_v3_enhanced
description: This version of the CWMAI evolutionary dependency management system enhances the core functionality by incorporating robust error recovery mechanisms to ensure smooth operation and data integrity even in the face of unexpected errors. It leverages a factuality checker to validate the evolved dependency graph against known facts and expert knowledge, minimizing the risk of introducing erroneous dependencies. Rollback mechanisms are also implemented for seamless reversion to previous stable states.
